name: Icy Mementos
body:
Drawbacks
Icy Mementos
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 19
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
As a parting gift, the shaman of your tribe gave you an alchemical concoction as a reminder of your icy home. You begin play with three bottles of liquid ice (Ultimate Equipment 108). These don’t count against your starting character wealth.
